site_name: Novva West Jordan campus (Salt Lake City flagship), 6524 W. Old Bingham Hwy, West Jordan, UT 84081
year_evidence_quote: announces today the opening of its flagship facility in Salt Lake City, Utah.
year_site_match: Novva's own release describes its 100-acre flagship Utah campus; image alt text on the page reads "Utah Data Center in Salt Lake City, UT, West Jordan". The 2020 Novva launch release says the campus is "Located in West Jordan, Utah", and the 2025 CIM release describes the same 100-acre West Jordan campus. No page opened shows the street address 6524 W. Old Bingham Hwy; Novva's pages list a business address of 6477 Wells Park Rd, West Jordan, UT 84081. The tie is by campus name and town (Novva describes one West Jordan campus), not by street address.
verification: The pages support 2021, NOT the claimed 2023. Evidence for 2021: (1) Novva release datelined September 17, 2021 announces the opening of the flagship facility, with a ribbon cutting on September 21; (2) Novva post dated October 25, 2021 (page title "Novva Data Centers Opens Flagship Facility in Salt Lake City Utah") describes the September 21 Grand Opening with customers attending; (3) Novva release dated January 17, 2022 says "During the build-out of its flagship center in Utah, which opened in September, Novva set out to become Utah's largest"; (4) Data Center Frontier, Oct. 24, 2022, describes the campus in present-tense operation ("The Novva campus currently uses about 1 million gallons a year of water"); (5) a May 8, 2023 Novva release calls West Jordan an existing facility. CONFLICT that the reviewer should weigh: the CIM Group/Novva financing release (Utah Business, March 6, 2025) says "The first phase of the campus began operations in 2023". That is a retrospective one-line statement in an investor release and is contradicted by the three contemporaneous operator pages and the 2022 trade article. I am uncertain what the 2023 statement refers to; possibly full Phase 1 commissioning or lease-up (the same release says the campus was fully leased in 2023), but that is inference, not verified. None of the 2021 pages states that customer IT load was live in 2021; they state the facility opened. If the study needs first customer load rather than facility opening, treat this as unresolved between 2021 and 2023. Street address not confirmed on any page. A guessed datacenterdynamics.com URL returned 403 and was not pursued; novva.com/data-centers/utah/ returned 404.

lead.year_evidence_quote: The first phase of the campus began operations in 2023.
lead.notes: The CIM/Novva release (Mar 2025) says Phase 1 began operations in 2023, with Phases 2 and 3 under construction for 2026. Confidence is medium, not high, because Novva's own post dated Oct 25, 2021 describes a Grand Opening on September 21 (2021) with customers present, so 2021 is a plausible alternative start; the facility then closed to public tours mid-November. Novva has one West Jordan campus, but no page I opened gives the street address.
